name: retro-ui
title: Windows 3.1 Kit
description: Windows 3.1 structure with a modern finish: window, button, fields, menubar, tabs, feedback and dialog.

files.content:
export { RetroWindow } from './retro-window'
export { RetroButton, RetroLinkButton } from './retro-button'
export { RetroInput, RetroSelect, RetroCheckbox, RetroRadio, RetroGroup } from './retro-fields'
export { RetroMenubar } from './retro-menubar'
export { RetroTabs, type RetroTab } from './retro-tabs'
export { RetroProgress, RetroBadge } from './retro-feedback'
export { RetroDialog } from './retro-dialog'
export {
  RetroTheme,
  RETRO_THEMES,
  RETRO_FONTS,
  type RetroThemeId,
  type RetroFontId,
} from './retro-theme'

theme.font-rt: var(--font-plex-sans, 'IBM Plex Sans'), ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif
theme.font-rt-mono: var(--font-plex-mono, 'IBM Plex Mono'), ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace
